verdict.rationale: The Department documents its own machine-oriented channels: an electronic file-and-pay program for large reemployment-tax data files with published XML schemas and XPath documents, and a batch enrollment file format for agents with 100+ clients. These cover only bulk return filing and client enrollment. Many other transactions are UI-only or manual: E-Verify decertification is done by email, viewing tax rates and returns or payment history requires the eFile login, and the business tax registration app is an authenticated interactive shell. missing for 10: a documented general-purpose API, programmatic equivalents for registration, payments, rate lookup, document lookup and certification changes, publicly available technical specs (batch specs are by email request only), and any evidence of UI/API parity.
